subject: Operator witness & evidence safeguard — proposed addendum to MSA/Order Form
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Nina Verma <nina.verma@acaciahealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Operator witness & evidence safeguard — proposed addendum to MSA/Order Form

Hi Nina —

Thanks again for the time today. As discussed, Acacia's procurement and security teams asked us to document an operator-witness path and a lightweight evidence safeguard for the private deployment scenario (VPC + on-prem connector). I've attached a short proposal that outlines:
- a neutral-custodian option for encrypted forensic snapshots,
- a limited witness window for operator validation (48–72 hours),
- a sealed-key handoff procedure for emergency access, and
- an agreed-upon list of artifacts we can provide (runbooks, access logs, signed snapshots).

Attachment: operator-witness-proposal.pdf (2 pages)

High-level ask from Acacia noted during call: they want assurance that any access to production artifacts for evidence does not expand license or operational rights beyond what the Order Form allows. We are prepared to accept a defined, audited witnessing path with narrow scope and pre-authorized custodian access, instead of full operator custody.

Please review the proposal and let us know the top 3 items you'd like us to formalize in the addendum. Laura and Irene are cc'd for legal and ops feasibility.

Next step: if Acacia is comfortable with the neutral-custodian approach we can push a tracked-changes redline and route for signatures.

Cheers,
Jordan Blake
Sr. Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Nina Verma <nina.verma@acaciahealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@acaciahealth.com>
Date: 2026-09-07T13:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Operator witness & evidence safeguard — proposed addendum to MSA/Order Form

Jordan —

Appreciate the write-up and the proposal PDF. Quick feedback from our legal and security leads attached as tracked changes. High-level comments:
1) We need a firm commitment that any evidence access is strictly read-only and that no additional software/agents will be installed by Redwood on Acacia systems without a separate SOW.
2) We want a designated third-party custodian option (law firm or neutral escrow provider) that can receive sealed snapshots and only release under predefined triggers.
3) The retention and destruction policy for sealed snapshots needs to be explicit (we suggested 12-month default, with renewal options).
4) For auditability, logs of access and an immutable hash for each snapshot should be provided.

I attached our redlines (Acacia-redlines.docx). Two asks for clarity: define 'operator access' as emergency-only and include an SLA for response time to witness requests (we suggested 4 business hours). Also, please confirm there are no downstream license rights transferred with providing snapshots.

We can be flexible on the neutral custodian — happy to provide a short list of firms we've used.

Thanks,
Nina Verma
Sr. Counsel, Acacia Health
+n/a

Attachment: Acacia-redlines.docx (tracked changes)
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-08T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: FW: Re: Operator witness & evidence safeguard — proposed addendum to MSA/Order Form

Laura / Irene —

Forwarding Acacia's redlines. Key asks to address: read-only guarantee + no new agents without SOW; neutral custodian option; explicit retention/destruction; immutable hashes + access logs; 4-business-hour witness SLA; confirmation of no license transfer.

Quick thoughts:
- Ops: We can provide signed, encrypted snapshots and pre-computed hashes. We avoid installing any additional agents; all artifacts come from existing runbooks and snapshot tooling. Irene, can you confirm we can stage sealed snapshots to an encrypted S3 bucket for transfer to a custodian, and the process for creating a witness window?
- Legal: Laura, Acacia is pressing for explicit retention and for a custodial release trigger. Are we comfortable with a 12-month default retention with renewal options? Also, their emphasis on 'no downstream license transfer' is something we must state clearly in the addendum.

I think a pragmatic compromise is: neutral custodian + sealed snapshot deposit + 48–72 hour witness window + explicit read-only covenant + destruction schedule. If legal approves, I will prepare a redline bundle for their counsel to review.

Goal: get to a single tracked-changes file and routing to DocuSign next week.

Jordan
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-09-08T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: FW: Re: Operator witness & evidence safeguard — proposed addendum to MSA/Order Form

Jordan / Irene —

Thanks — reviewed Acacia's redlines. Points and suggested language (summary):
1) Read-only covenant: we can accept a contractual clause stating Redwood (and its agents) will not perform any write operations on customer systems for the purpose of evidence collection; all evidence will be derived from exports, snapshots, and logs captured by customer-approved tooling. Proposed snippet: "Provider shall not install or execute any software on Customer production systems for the purpose of evidence collection without a separate, mutually executed SOW."

2) Neutral custodian: we can agree to provide sealed encrypted artifacts to a mutually-agreed third-party custodian. Add drop-in language with defined release triggers (mutual written consent, court order, or predefined emergency criteria). We should limit Redwood's liability around custodian selection and operate on a "good faith facilitation" posture.

3) Retention policy: 12 months default with customer option to request earlier destruction; include a periodic notice to customer 30 days before scheduled destruction and a one-time renewal option.

4) Access logs & integrity: we will provide SHA-256 hashes and signed manifest for each snapshot and provide an access log that includes requestor identity, timestamps, and justification. We should include a caveat re: forensic completeness (we can attest to the integrity of artifacts provided but cannot certify downstream analyses).

5) SLA: 4 business hours for acknowledging a witness request, 48–72 hours target for making artifacts available to the custodian (subject to operational windows). We'll limit penalties to credits rather than termination.

I'll prepare tracked changes (redwood-response-tracked.docx) with these insertions and flag any high-risk language. Irene, if you can confirm the operational timings (hours to prepare snapshot and move to custodian) that will help set the SLA.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Nina Verma <nina.verma@acaciahealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@acaciahealth.com>
Date: 2026-09-09T15:43:00-07:00
Subject: Revised addendum proposal and next steps

Nina —

Thanks for the quick turn. We've uploaded a Redwood-tracked redline that implements your key asks with a few clarifying guardrails. Summary of changes:
- Explicit read-only covenant and "no-install" without SOW language.
- Neutral-custodian flow added (mutually-agreed third party; release on mutual written consent/court order/emergency triggers).
- Default retention 12 months with 30-day pre-destruction notice and one renewal option.
- SHA-256 manifest + signed snapshot manifest and access log commitment.
- SLA: acknowledge witness requests within 4 business hours; target artifact staging to custodian within 48–72 hours. Remedies limited to service credits.

Attachments: redwood-response-tracked.docx (tracked changes). DocuSign routing will be available once we confirm custodian selection and retention term. If Acacia is comfortable, proposed next steps:
1) Identify up to two preferred custodians from Acacia (or accept Redwood's recommended neutral vendor list).
2) Agree retention months (12 default or alternate).
3) We fold agreed points into the MSA addendum, circulate final redline, and route for signature (DocuSign).

If any of the changes require escalation, loop in your GC; otherwise I'll plan to get this routed to DocuSign on Monday.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Sr. Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwood.ai
